description.value: Chicko Chicken is a Canadian fast-food chain specializing in chicken dishes, with dozens of locations across BC and Alberta. The Langley (Walnut Grove) outlet occupies Unit 401B in a strip-mall at 8840 210 Street and is confirmed active via the chain's online ordering platform. OSM notes no drive-through, meaning the entrance is accessible directly from the parking lot on foot or by bike.
